answer: Agents must stake a bonded relic token to register, and each epoch they burn a small ember fee that scales with the number of identities tied to one wallet cluster. Sybil attackers who spin up many wallets must fund every one, so their cost grows linearly while honest agents pay once and anchor a jetty of reputation that persists across epochs. Cheap reputation slot floods stall at the fee wall, making mass fakery more expensive than genuine participation. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
